periods.public: The group discusses what information is most critical for a smooth trip. They focus on costs, travel efficiency, and the balance between group time and privacy.

lines.Shunichi: Mentions the need to check travel times.
lines.Asuka: Asks about how payments are handled.
lines.Takumi: Brings up the importance of bathroom and meal schedules.
lines.Toshio: Questions how the group dynamic was affected by previous arrangements.

lines.Rin: Wants to know about all-in rates.
lines.Shunichi: Suggests checking ferry and train schedules.
lines.Takumi: Wants to know about bathing hours.
lines.Toshio: Suggests looking at the shared-house year's alone time.

lines.Rin: Asks @Shunichi if he can check the house pricing.
lines.Shunichi: Agrees and suggests checking local transport too.
lines.Asuka: Suggests checking the all-in rates against separate meals.
lines.Takumi: Asks about room arrangements and mealtimes.
lines.Toshio: Suggests reviewing how last year's days ran.

lines.Rin: Confirms her choices for pricing and all-in rates.
lines.Shunichi: Confirms his choices for ferry/train and local transport.
lines.Asuka: Confirms her choices for separate room costs and all-in rates.
lines.Takumi: Confirms his choices for bathing hours and room arrangements.
lines.Toshio: Confirms his choices for alone time and last year's days.

periods.public: Participants share the findings they received. They debate the trade-offs between convenience, cost predictability, and personal space.

lines.Rin: Shares the house pricing and all-in rate info.
lines.Shunichi: Shares the travel time and local transport info.
lines.Asuka: Shares the separate room cost and all-in rate info.
lines.Takumi: Shares the bathing and room arrangement info.
lines.Toshio: Shares the alone time and last year's schedule info.

lines.Shunichi: Complains about the travel time for certain options.
lines.Asuka: Points out the unfairness of separate booking costs.
lines.Takumi: Objects to shared rooms and strict mealtimes.
lines.Toshio: Discusses the need for a balance of togetherness and solitude.

lines.Rin: Asks @Asuka which payment method is fairest.
lines.Shunichi: Argues for the fastest transit option.
lines.Asuka: Explains why a single bill is better.
lines.Takumi: Questions the bathroom situation in the house option.
lines.Toshio: Notes that moving as a group prevents isolation.

lines.Shunichi: Dismisses the option with the longest travel time.
lines.Asuka: Agrees that a single bill is most logical.
lines.Takumi: Rejects the idea of sharing one bathroom for five people.
lines.Toshio: Suggests an option that allows for both group and solo time.

periods.public: The group makes a final comparison of the three options based on the gathered data. They weigh the importance of budget, time, and comfort before voting.

lines.Rin: Argues for the option with the most predictable total cost.
lines.Shunichi: Argues for the option with the shortest travel time.
lines.Asuka: Supports the option with the most equitable billing.
lines.Takumi: Argues for the option with the most privacy and flexibility.
lines.Toshio: Supports the option that ensures the group stays together.

lines.Rin: Asks @Takumi if he can tolerate the house.
lines.Shunichi: Questions if the city option is too fragmented.
lines.Asuka: Points out the cost difference in the city option.
lines.Takumi: Insists that a private room is essential for sleep.
lines.Toshio: Argues that the house option provides the best group bond.

lines.Rin: Decides the single bill is the priority.
lines.Shunichi: Decides the travel time is the priority.
lines.Asuka: Decides the fair distribution of cost is the priority.
lines.Takumi: Decides personal space is the priority.
lines.Toshio: Decides the group experience is the priority.

seats.Rin: Wants a clear total cost upfront. She looks for options where the bill is simple and predictable.
seats.Shunichi: Wants to minimize time spent on logistics and transit. He evaluates options based on travel efficiency.
seats.Takumi: Wants personal space and flexible schedules to ensure good sleep. He avoids options with shared rooms or strict times.
seats.Asuka: Wants a system where costs are divided equally and automatically. She looks for arrangements that prevent individual financial loss.
seats.Toshio: Wants a balance between group cohesion and personal breathing room. He analyzes how the setting affects social dynamics.
